definitions.explanation: Expresses that despite any amount of effort or quantity, the result remains the same.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：01449_setsumei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much I explain, they don't understand.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{太|ふと}らない→太る：01190_futoru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much I eat, I don't gain weight.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{来|こ}なかった→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how long I waited, they didn't come.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦{頑張|がんば}って→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}からない→受かる：19367_ukaru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how hard I try, I can't pass the exam.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much money you have, it's meaningless if you don't have time.

notes:
いくら〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ is a grammar pattern expressing that regardless of the degree or amount, the result does not change. It conveys a sense of futility or emphasis.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- いくら + verb (て-form) + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: いくら⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (no matter how much I eat)
- いくら + i-adjective (-くて⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧): いくら⟦{高|たか}くて→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (no matter how expensive)
- いくら + na-adjective / noun (⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧): いくら⟦{静|しず}かで→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (no matter how quiet)

USAGE:
The main clause typically states a negative or unexpected outcome: いくら⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：01449_setsumei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (no matter how much I explain, they don't understand).
いくら can also be used alone to mean "how much" (as a question word) or "some amount."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どんなに→どんなに：03494_donnani⟧〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: no matter how (interchangeable in most cases)
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: no matter how many times (focuses on repetition)
- ⟦たとえ→たとえ：03405_tatoe⟧〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: even if (more hypothetical)
